title: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1.1: Evidence-State Reasoning Benchmark for Selective Arabic RAG
description: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1.1 is the post-review archival release of the controlled Arabic benchmark for temporal evidence validity, directed evidence relations, query-conditioned evidence states, state-aware reranking, and selective actions in retrieval-augmented generation. The core v1.1 benchmark, labels, frozen BM25/Dense-E5 predictions, thresholds, and frozen reranking configuration are unchanged. Version 1.1.1 adds reviewer-requested supplementary diagnostics, including the Direct Relation Policy comparator, temporal-date heuristic, reranking-weight and state/graph sensitivity analyses, transition-cue dropout, blind benchmark-label audit summaries, and source-diversity/provenance summaries.
notes: Zenodo version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23703633. Concept DOI for all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.23277315. The CC BY 4.0 license applies to original AraVISTA benchmark content and annotations. Linked official webpages remain third-party materials subject to their original terms.
